text:
Predicates:
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
ContainsKnowledge(x) ::: x contains knowledge.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x becomes smarter.
Premises:
∀x (Book(x) → ContainsKnowledge(x)) ::: Books contain tons of knowledge.
∀x ∀y ((Person(x) ∧ Reads(x, y) ∧ Book(y)) → GainsKnowledge(x)) ::: When a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge.
∀x (GainsKnowledge(x) → Smarter(x)) ::: If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter.
Reads(harry, walden) ∧ Book(walden) ::: Harry read the book “Walden” by Henry Thoreau.
Conclusion:
Smarter(harry) ::: Harry is smarter than before.
